topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by reviewing histopathology practicals and setting out the lecture learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes and assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular oncogenes and the development of laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classifications and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the concepts and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate their molecular mechanisms using the Rb and p53 pathways.

topics.label: Types, mechanisms, and consequences of genetic instability in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how specific defects in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and mitotic segregation drive sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the multi-step model of mutation accumulation in tumorigenesis and explore how inherited germline mutations accelerate this progression.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by offering book recommendations and previewing the upcoming lecture.
